name: Sony BRAVIA XR-55A95L (A95L, 2023 QD-OLED; Android reports BRAVIA 4K AE1, BRAVIA_AE_M6L, MediaTek MT5838), EU
warnings: It also plays the HDMI inputs, so keep it even if you never watch broadcast TV; set it as live_tv_package and in hidden_apps (config.json here).
